content:
Nina Torres: Quick follow-up on the flare yesterday — auth vendor throttled refreshes which cascaded into registry 502s and intermittent LB failures. Need owners for the follow-ups.
Alex Mercer: tl;dr: thousands of short-lived token refreshes at once -> vendor 429s -> our retries + registry retries -> 502 spike.
Samira Khan: timeline I saw: spike started 21:08 UTC, vendor 429s hit 21:11, registry errors by 21:13, LB health rotations 21:16-21:30. Autoscaling smoothed things by 21:38.
Diego Alvarez: Vendor response: they've granted a 48h throttle relaxation while we implement mitigations; opened ticket AUTH-2246. They want a written mitigation plan.
Nina Torres: Immediate hotfix (low risk): bump client token cache TTL 30s->300s, add refresh jitter, and per-subject dedupe/serialization. Owners?
Alex Mercer: I'll own config push + canary. Samira will own tests + runbook. Diego, vendor comms.
Samira Khan: Tests: simulate 400 simultaneous refreshes in staging and assert vendor 429s are within acceptable bounds. I'll run tomorrow 08:00 PT.
Nina Torres: Alerts to add: `auth.refresh_concurrency > 40 for 3m` and `modelregistry.502_rate > 5/min`. Also composite alert for both.
Diego Alvarez: I'll draft vendor mitigation request: logs for 21:00-21:45 UTC, temporary throttle lift, and ask for an SLA addendum on burst handling. Looping in vendor-bot.
vendor-bot: AUTH-2246 updated: vendor provided logs (S3 link) and temporary throttle window set for 48h.
ops-bot: Task created: "Auth refresh hotfix" assigned to Alex Mercer, Samira Khan. Due in 24h. Reminder at 8h.
Alex Mercer: planned config snippet for canary:
```
auth_client:
  token_cache_ttl_sec: 300
  refresh_jitter_ms: 200-1000
  dedupe_window_ms: 4000
retries:
  on_429: exponential_backoff(200ms, max=6s, attempts=6)
```
Samira Khan: note on risk — longer TTL increases window for revoked tokens. Add revocation webhook to invalidate caches immediately. I'll add as a 48h task.
Nina Torres: owners & timeline summary:
- Hotfix (24h): Alex (config + canary) + Samira (tests)
- Short-term (7d): Samira (runbook, alerts, dashboard showing top refreshers), Diego (vendor SLA/logs + legal loop)
- Long-term (6-8w): infra (gateway circuit-breaker + signed-token evaluation)
Alex Mercer: pushing canary now (5% hosts). Will report canary metrics in 30m.
Samira Khan: I'll validate staging harness and post results here after the run.
Diego Alvarez: I'll circulate the vendor mitigation draft within 6h. If no firm commitment, escalate to partner ops.
Nina Torres: Thanks all — follow-up sync in 24h after canary. If you hit blockers, put them here. :eyes:"
